zh-CN.title: 桌面聊天工作台焕新
items: 会话列表与聊天内容整合为统一的大圆角工作台，减少多层卡片与重复信息
统一会话标题栏高度，并优化桌面与手机端的聊天详情按钮

en.title: Refined desktop chat workspace
items: Combined the conversation list and chat into one spacious rounded workspace with less visual repetition
Aligned conversation header heights and refined the shared chat details button across desktop and mobile
